prompt:
Use the attached approved “Personal Orrery” interface comp only as a material, lighting, and mechanical-craft reference. Do not reproduce or rasterize its interface content.

Create one production-ready full-bleed background material plate for the immersive stage of the DeepSeek Harness Mind Garden web plugin. Target composition: 2880 × 1800 pixels, 16:10 landscape. This image will sit underneath live semantic HTML, authored SVG, and WebGL, so it must contain only non-interactive atmosphere and physical housing.

Composition: an edge-to-edge dark observatory work surface made from matte graphite lacquer, deep oxidized-teal enamel, and smoked glass. Place one large front-facing circular instrument housing with its center at approximately 43% of the canvas width and 50% of the canvas height; its outside diameter is approximately 78% of the canvas height. Render only the non-interactive outer chassis: an aged-brass bezel, matte graphite backing, restrained screws and lugs, and four to six small adjustment housings with shallow believable mechanical depth. The central 68% of the circular housing must remain a calm, uninterrupted, low-detail smoked-glass aperture so live SVG orbital rings, ticks, labels, and WebGL nodes can be drawn over it. Keep the rightmost 24% of the canvas as a quiet, low-detail deep-enamel field for a responsive semantic observatory ledger. Do not render a ledger frame.

Materials and lighting: physically convincing smoked glass, fine deep-teal enamel, hand-rubbed aged brass with restrained patina, subtle warm amber dust caught in very low grazing light from the upper left, delicate internal teal depth, readable shadow detail, museum-grade precision-instrument finish. Include only a sparse static layer of very small warm dust flecks; live particles will be added in WebGL. Keep the central 60% visually calm enough for high-contrast text and controls. Use a front-on, almost orthographic camera with no room, horizon, table, or poster-like vignette. Keep all important housing detail at least 5% inside the canvas edges so centered responsive crops remain usable.

Strict exclusions: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, Chinese characters, interface controls, buttons, cards, navigation, ledger content, people, faces, hands, portraits, personal objects, photographs, or specific private events. No orbital rings, concentric tracks, calibration ticks, degree marks, compass, astrolabe diagram, planets, interactive stars, memory nodes, or connecting lines. No rough rocks, geological slabs, mineral crags, gold splatter, repeated texture, generic galaxy wallpaper, nebula, neon blue, purple, sci-fi cockpit, fantasy game art, steampunk ornament overload, or ornate antique illustration.

Output one opaque, edge-to-edge image with no transparency and no artificial border. The result must feel intimate, warm, technically extraordinary, calm enough for daily use, and materially richer than the rejected white editorial version while remaining subordinate to the live interface layered above it.
